title: Prime Minister shares an article highlighting India as an island of stability and an engine of growth
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi, today shared an article by Shri Harish Salve highlighting how India has stood out as an island of stability and an engine of growth during a tumultuous period.
Shri Salve attributes this to the Prime Minister’s stable leadership and political continuity, noting that a clear sense of national direction has strengthened India’s economy, foreign policy and long-term nation-building.
The Prime Minister’s Office posted on X:
“India has stood out as an island of stability and an engine of growth during a tumultuous period, Shri Harish Salve writes.
He attributes this to PM @narendramodi's stable leadership and political continuity, saying a clear sense of national direction has strengthened India's economy, foreign policy and long-term nation-building.”
